pool.text: Portuguese explorer António de Faria visited and anchored in Da Nang.
A name appears on maps of the area drafted by Alexandre de Rhodes.
The Điện Hải Citadel was first built as an earthen fortress.
John White arrived at Da Nang in the brig Franklin.
Gia Long's son Minh Mạng rebuilt the original Điện Hải fortress.
Emperor Minh Mạng issued an edict prohibiting European vessels from trade except at Đà Nẵng.
Da Nang was separated from Quảng Nam province to become a centrally controlled municipality.
The Hải Vân Tunnel was built and opened to cut down transit time.
Da Nang's GDP per capita reached 19 million VND.
Exports increased to US$575 million in the area.
Da Nang Hi-Tech Park was established as one of the national parks.
Air Asia began offering four flights a week between Đà Nẵng and Kuala Lumpur.
The traditional stone-carving craft was added to Vietnam's national intangible cultural heritage list.
Da Nang was voted one of the top 10 resort destinations in Asia.
APEC summit events were hosted in this city.
The Golden Bridge phenomenon became a focal point on some newspapers.
The American newspaper New York Times praised Da Nang as the Miami of Vietnam.
Đà Nẵng received a score of 68.79 in the Provincial Competitiveness Index.
Huỳnh Thị Thanh Thủy became Miss International.
The new Da Nang city was formed by reabsorbing Quảng Nam.
